title: The Star in a Puddle
youtube_title: The Star in a Puddle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Pema finds a star shaken into pieces by a puddle and then whole again. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Pema shows Ulla how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
